summary: Duran's Green Party platform for Texas's 28th district frames the Free Palestine struggle in anti-apartheid terms, drawing parallels to South Africa and South Texas indigenous rights, and calls for justice, human dignity, and international law to guide policy rather than PAC money. In March 2026 he pledged to accept no AIPAC or any PAC funding.
